html:
The Kwikwetlem (Coquitlam) are a Coast Salish people of the Coquitlam River and the lower Fraser River east of what is now Vancouver, British Columbia. Their name is usually explained as "red fish up the river", after the sockeye salmon that once ran there.

They speak the downriver dialect of Halkomelem, like their neighbours the Kwantlen, the Musqueam and the Stó:lō. Dams and settlement in the 1900s ended the sockeye run and shrank their land to small reserves.
